title: Day one, before you type
caption: Four short lines. Two minutes. Then type.

why-check-is-on-the-list.header: Why check is on the list
why-check-is-on-the-list.description: Anthropic's guidance for its coding agent is to give it a way to verify its work and, if you cannot verify it, not to ship it. The page was quoted from an earlier fetch, not re-fetched.[1]

a-short-checklist-can-cut-errors.header: A short checklist can cut errors in skilled work
a-short-checklist-can-cut-errors.description: A 19-item surgical checklist was associated with inpatient death falling from 1.5% to 0.8%. This is surgery, not AI; it shows only that a simple step helps experts.[1]

surgical-safety-checklist.title: A Surgical Safety Checklist to Reduce Morbidity and Mortality in a Global Population

keep-the-note-short.description: A line stays only if removing it would cause mistakes; bloated instruction files lead the model to ignore the actual instructions.[1]

next-time.title: Next time
next-time.script: So here is your move. Next time you reach for AI on something real, stop. Before you type a single word.

jot-it-down.title: Jot it down
jot-it-down.script: Take a piece of paper, or an empty note. And write down what you would tell a brand-new colleague on their first day.

four-lines.title: Four lines
four-lines.script: Four short lines. The context. The tools they would need. The brief. And how you will check their work.

two-minutes.title: Two minutes
two-minutes.script: It takes two minutes. Keep it small. Then, and only then, type.
